fact.zh: 兩個氫原子手牽手,是宇宙中最輕的氣體。
fact.en: Two hydrogen atoms holding hands: the lightest gas of all.

use.zh: 燃料電池車的燃料,燃燒後只會變成水!
use.en: Fuel-cell car fuel. It burns into plain water!

factTeen.zh: 兩個氫原子共用一對電子,形成最簡單的分子,也是最輕的氣體。
factTeen.en: Two hydrogen atoms share one pair of electrons, making the simplest molecule and the lightest gas.

factHigh.zh: 兩個 H 原子共用一對電子形成的雙原子分子,是密度最小的氣體。
factHigh.en: A diatomic molecule formed when two H atoms share one electron pair; the least dense of all gases.

useTeen.zh: 燃料電池的燃料,燃燒後只生成水。
useTeen.en: Fuel for fuel cells; it burns to give only water.

useHigh.zh: 作為燃料電池與氫能車的燃料,燃燒產物只有水;也是工業合成氨的原料。
useHigh.en: Fuel for fuel cells and hydrogen vehicles, with water as the only combustion product; also a feedstock for ammonia synthesis.

fact.zh: 兩個氧原子用「雙鍵」抓得緊緊的。
fact.en: Two oxygen atoms joined by a double bond.

use.zh: 我們每一口呼吸都需要它,火也需要它才會燃燒。
use.en: Every breath needs it, and fire needs it to burn.

factTeen.zh: 兩個氧原子共用兩對電子,形成雙鍵。
factTeen.en: Two oxygen atoms share two pairs of electrons, forming a double bond.

factHigh.zh: 兩個氧原子以雙鍵(共用兩對電子)結合;O₂ 是供呼吸、助燃的氣體。
factHigh.en: Two oxygen atoms joined by a double bond (two shared pairs); O₂ is the gas we breathe and the one that supports combustion.

useTeen.zh: 供生物呼吸,也是燃燒必需的助燃氣體。
useTeen.en: Needed for breathing, and the gas that supports burning.

useHigh.zh: 呼吸作用與燃燒的氧化劑,約占空氣體積的 21%。
useHigh.en: The oxidant for respiration and combustion; about 21% of air by volume.

fact.zh: 三個氧原子彎彎的排在一起,有一點特別的味道。
fact.en: Three oxygen atoms in a bent shape, with a sharp smell.

use.zh: 高空的臭氧層像大雨傘,幫我們擋住太陽的紫外線。
use.en: The ozone layer is a giant umbrella blocking the Sun's UV rays.

factTeen.zh: 三個氧原子排成彎曲形,有特殊的氣味。
factTeen.en: Three oxygen atoms in a bent shape, with a distinctive smell.

useTeen.zh: 高空的臭氧層可以吸收來自太陽的紫外線。
useTeen.en: The ozone layer high above absorbs ultraviolet light from the Sun.

factHigh.zh: 三個氧原子組成的彎曲形分子(鍵角約 117°),是氧的同素異形體,具有共振結構。
factHigh.en: A bent molecule of three oxygen atoms (bond angle about 117°); an allotrope of oxygen with resonance structures.

useHigh.zh: 平流層的臭氧層吸收波長較短的紫外線;近地面的臭氧則是空氣汙染物。
useHigh.en: The stratospheric ozone layer absorbs short-wavelength ultraviolet light; ozone near the ground is an air pollutant.

fact.zh: 兩個氮原子用「三鍵」緊緊相連,非常穩定。
fact.en: Two nitrogen atoms joined by a very strong triple bond.

use.zh: 佔空氣的 78%;洋芋片包裝充氮氣,可以保持酥脆。
use.en: 78% of air. Chip bags are filled with it to stay crunchy.

factTeen.zh: 兩個氮原子以三鍵結合,非常穩定,不容易起反應。
factTeen.en: Two nitrogen atoms joined by a triple bond; very stable and slow to react.

useTeen.zh: 約占空氣的 78%;食品包裝充氮氣可以延緩變質。
useTeen.en: About 78% of air; nitrogen-filled food packaging slows spoilage.

factHigh.zh: N≡N 叄鍵的鍵能很大(約 945 kJ/mol),所以 N₂ 極不活潑。
factHigh.en: The N≡N triple bond is very strong (about 945 kJ/mol), so N₂ is extremely unreactive.

useHigh.zh: 約占空氣體積的 78%;是合成氨(哈伯法)的原料,液態氮可作冷卻劑。
useHigh.en: About 78% of air by volume; a feedstock for ammonia (Haber process), and liquid nitrogen is used as a coolant.

fact.zh: 一個氧原子加兩個氫原子,像一張小小的笑臉。
fact.en: One oxygen and two hydrogens, like a tiny smiley face.

use.zh: 生命的泉源!我們身體約有 60% 是水。
use.en: The source of life! About 60% of your body is water.

factTeen.zh: 由一個氧原子和兩個氫原子組成的彎曲形分子。
factTeen.en: A bent molecule made of one oxygen atom and two hydrogen atoms.

useTeen.zh: 生命不可缺少的物質,人體約 60% 是水。
useTeen.en: Essential for life; about 60% of the human body is water.

factHigh.zh: 極性分子(鍵角約 104.5°),分子間有氫鍵,所以沸點比同類的小分子高很多。
factHigh.en: A polar molecule (bond angle about 104.5°) with hydrogen bonding between molecules, so its boiling point is far higher than that of similar small molecules.

useHigh.zh: 極佳的溶劑,是生物體內化學反應的介質;人體重量約 60% 是水。
useHigh.en: An excellent solvent and the medium for reactions in living things; about 60% of body weight is water.

howto.zh: 拼法:先把 2 個 O 牽在一起,再在每個 O 上各牽 1 個 H。
howto.en: Build: join 2 O atoms, then attach 1 H to each O.

fact.zh: 比水多一個氧原子。
fact.en: Water with one extra oxygen.

use.zh: 稀釋後可以幫傷口消毒、漂白衣服(請大人幫忙使用)。
use.en: Diluted, it disinfects and bleaches (ask a grown-up).

factHigh.zh: 比水多一個氧的過氧化物,含 O–O 單鍵,不穩定,容易分解成水與氧氣。
factHigh.en: A peroxide with one more oxygen than water; it contains an O–O single bond and readily decomposes into water and oxygen.

useHigh.zh: 稀溶液(約 3%)用於消毒與漂白,高濃度則是強氧化劑。
useHigh.en: Dilute solutions (about 3%) are used for disinfection and bleaching; concentrated solutions are strong oxidizers.

howto.zh: 拼法:讓 1 個 C 在中間,左右各牽 1 個 O(每個 O 會用兩隻手抓緊 C)。
howto.en: Build: put 1 C in the middle with 1 O on each side. Each O grips C with two hands.

fact.zh: 一個碳原子抱著兩個氧原子,排成一直線。
fact.en: A carbon atom holding two oxygens in a straight line.

use.zh: 汽水的氣泡就是它!植物也用它來做光合作用。
use.en: The bubbles in soda! Plants use it for photosynthesis.

factTeen.zh: 一個碳原子連著兩個氧原子,排成一直線。
factTeen.en: One carbon atom bonded to two oxygen atoms in a straight line.

useTeen.zh: 汽水的氣泡就是它,植物行光合作用也需要它。
useTeen.en: The bubbles in soda are CO₂, and plants need it for photosynthesis.

factHigh.zh: 直線形分子(O=C=O)。C=O 鍵有極性,但分子對稱,所以整個分子是非極性分子。
factHigh.en: A linear molecule (O=C=O). Each C=O bond is polar, but the molecule is symmetric, so overall it is nonpolar.

useHigh.zh: 光合作用的原料、碳酸飲料的氣體來源,也是主要的溫室氣體之一。
useHigh.en: A raw material for photosynthesis, the gas in carbonated drinks, and one of the main greenhouse gases.

fact.zh: 燃燒不完全時會產生,無色無味但有毒。
fact.en: Made when fuel burns incompletely. Colorless, odorless and poisonous.

use.zh: 使用瓦斯熱水器要保持通風,避免中毒。
use.en: Keep rooms ventilated when using gas heaters.

factHigh.zh: 含 C≡O 叄鍵,不完全燃燒時產生;與血紅素的結合力遠大於氧,會使人缺氧中毒。
factHigh.en: It has a C≡O triple bond and forms during incomplete combustion; it binds hemoglobin far more strongly than oxygen does, causing oxygen starvation.

useHigh.zh: 工業上用作還原劑(如煉鐵)與合成氣的成分。
useHigh.en: Used industrially as a reducing agent (for example in ironmaking) and as a component of synthesis gas.

howto.zh: 拼法:把 3 個 H 都牽在 1 個 N 上。
howto.en: Build: attach 3 H atoms to 1 N.

fact.zh: 一個氮原子加三個氫原子,像一座小金字塔。
fact.en: A nitrogen with three hydrogens, shaped like a little pyramid.

use.zh: 用來製造肥料,味道很刺鼻。
use.en: Used to make fertilizer. It has a sharp smell.

factHigh.zh: 三角錐形(鍵角約 107°),N 上有一對孤對電子,是極性分子,極易溶於水,水溶液呈弱鹼性。
factHigh.en: Trigonal pyramidal (bond angle about 107°) with a lone pair on N; a polar molecule, very soluble in water, giving a weakly basic solution.

useHigh.zh: 以哈伯法合成,是製造肥料與硝酸的原料。
useHigh.en: Made by the Haber process; a feedstock for fertilizers and nitric acid.

howto.zh: 拼法:把 4 個 H 都牽在 1 個 C 上。
howto.en: Build: attach 4 H atoms to 1 C.

fact.zh: 一個碳原子被四個氫原子圍住,形狀像小金字塔(正四面體)。
fact.en: A carbon surrounded by four hydrogens in a tetrahedron.

use.zh: 天然氣的主要成分,家裡煮飯的瓦斯就是它。
use.en: The main part of natural gas, used for cooking.

factTeen.zh: 一個碳原子連著四個氫原子,形狀是正四面體。
factTeen.en: One carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms in a regular tetrahedron.

useTeen.zh: 天然氣的主要成分,家用瓦斯的燃料。
useTeen.en: The main component of natural gas, used as household fuel.

factHigh.zh: sp³ 混成的正四面體分子,鍵角約 109.5°,是最簡單的烷類(烴)。
factHigh.en: A regular tetrahedral molecule with sp³ hybridization and bond angles of about 109.5°; the simplest alkane (hydrocarbon).

useHigh.zh: 天然氣的主要成分,也是重要的溫室氣體。
useHigh.en: The main component of natural gas, and an important greenhouse gas.

fact.zh: 溶在水裡就是鹽酸,我們的胃液裡也有它!
fact.en: Dissolved in water it is hydrochloric acid, which is also in your stomach!

use.zh: 幫助胃消化食物(濃度很低);工廠用來清除鐵鏽。
use.en: Helps digest food; factories use it to remove rust.

factHigh.zh: 氣體溶於水即為鹽酸,是強酸,在水中完全解離成 H⁺ 與 Cl⁻。
factHigh.en: The gas dissolves in water to give hydrochloric acid, a strong acid that dissociates completely into H⁺ and Cl⁻.

useHigh.zh: 胃液含有稀鹽酸;工業上用於酸洗除鏽與製造氯化物。
useHigh.en: Gastric juice contains dilute hydrochloric acid; industry uses it for pickling (rust removal) and making chlorides.

fact.zh: 鈉和氯整齊地交錯排列成方塊晶體。
fact.en: Sodium and chlorine alternate in a neat cubic crystal.

use.zh: 每天的調味料。鈉遇水會爆炸,氯有毒,結合後卻很安全!
use.en: Our everyday seasoning. Sodium and chlorine are dangerous alone, yet safe together!

factTeen.zh: 鈉離子和氯離子整齊地交錯排列,形成立方體的晶體。
factTeen.en: Sodium ions and chloride ions alternate in an orderly pattern, forming cubic crystals.

useTeen.zh: 食鹽,日常的調味料。
useTeen.en: Table salt, an everyday seasoning.

factHigh.zh: 離子晶體:Na⁺ 與 Cl⁻ 以離子鍵結合,排成面心立方(岩鹽)結構,每個離子被 6 個相反電荷的離子包圍。
factHigh.en: An ionic crystal: Na⁺ and Cl⁻ are held by ionic bonds in a face-centered cubic (rock salt) structure, each ion surrounded by 6 oppositely charged ions.

useHigh.zh: 食鹽的主要成分,用於調味與食品保存;電解熔融的 NaCl 可製得鈉與氯氣。
useHigh.en: The main component of table salt, used for seasoning and preservation; electrolysis of molten NaCl gives sodium and chlorine.

howto.zh: 拼法:先把 2 個 C 牽在一起。第一個 C 再牽 3 個 H;第二個 C 牽 2 個 H 和 1 個 O;最後把 1 個 H 牽在 O 上。
howto.en: Build: join 2 C atoms. Give the first C 3 H. Give the second C 2 H and 1 O. Finally attach 1 H to the O.

fact.zh: 碳、氫、氧三種原子一起組成。
fact.en: Built from carbon, hydrogen and oxygen.

use.zh: 酒精消毒液可以殺死細菌(兒童不能喝含酒精飲料)。
use.en: Rubbing alcohol kills germs.

factTeen.zh: 由碳、氫、氧三種原子組成的酒精(乙醇)。
factTeen.en: Alcohol (ethanol), made of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen atoms.

useTeen.zh: 消毒用酒精可以殺菌;酒類含有乙醇(未成年人不可飲酒)。
useTeen.en: Rubbing alcohol kills germs; alcoholic drinks contain ethanol (not for minors).

factHigh.zh: 含羥基(–OH)的醇類,分子式 C₂H₆O,可與水以任意比例互溶。
factHigh.en: An alcohol containing a hydroxyl group (–OH), molecular formula C₂H₆O, miscible with water in any proportion.

useHigh.zh: 常用的溶劑與消毒劑(約 75% 的酒精殺菌效果最佳),也可作為燃料。
useHigh.en: A common solvent and disinfectant (about 75% alcohol works best), and also usable as a fuel.

howto.zh: 拼法:1) 先把 2 個 C 牽在一起。2) 左邊的 C 牽 3 個 H。3) 右邊的 C 牽 2 個 O。4) 其中一個 O 再牽 1 個 H,沒牽 H 的那個 O 會自動用兩隻手抓緊 C。
howto.en: Build: 1) Join 2 C atoms. 2) Give the left C 3 H. 3) Attach 2 O atoms to the right C. 4) Attach 1 H to one of those O atoms. The O without H grips C with two hands.

fact.zh: 食用醋酸酸的味道就是它。
fact.en: The sour taste of vinegar.

use.zh: 廚房的醋,可以拿來調味、清除水垢。
use.en: Kitchen vinegar for seasoning and cleaning limescale.

factTeen.zh: 食用醋的酸味來自它。
factTeen.en: It gives vinegar its sour taste.

useTeen.zh: 廚房的食用醋,可以調味,也能去除水垢。
useTeen.en: Kitchen vinegar, used for seasoning and for removing limescale.

factHigh.zh: 含羧基(–COOH)的弱酸,食用醋中約含 4~5% 的醋酸。
factHigh.en: A weak acid containing a carboxyl group (–COOH); table vinegar contains about 4–5% acetic acid.

useHigh.zh: 食用醋的酸味來源,也是工業上製造醋酸酯與塑膠原料的化學品。
useHigh.en: The source of the sour taste of vinegar, and an industrial chemical for making acetate esters and plastics.

howto.zh: 拼法:先把 3 個 C 排成一排牽起來。兩端的 C 各牽 3 個 H,中間的 C 牽 2 個 H。
howto.en: Build: join 3 C atoms in a row. Give each end C 3 H and the middle C 2 H.

fact.zh: 三個碳排成一排,身上穿著八件氫外套。
fact.en: Three carbons in a row wearing eight hydrogens.

use.zh: 桶裝瓦斯、露營瓦斯爐的燃料。
use.en: Fuel for gas bottles and camping stoves.

factTeen.zh: 三個碳排成一排,連接八個氫原子。
factTeen.en: Three carbon atoms in a row carrying eight hydrogen atoms.

useTeen.zh: 桶裝瓦斯與露營瓦斯爐的燃料。
useTeen.en: Fuel for bottled gas and camping stoves.

factHigh.zh: 含三個碳的烷類(C₃H₈),加壓即可液化,方便儲存。
factHigh.en: A three-carbon alkane (C₃H₈) that liquefies under modest pressure, which makes it easy to store.

useHigh.zh: 液化石油氣(LPG)的主要成分之一,用作家用與露營燃料。
useHigh.en: A main component of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), used as household and camping fuel.

howto.zh: 拼法:先讓 C 在中間,牽上 3 個 O。再把 H 牽在其中一個 O 上,Na 牽在另一個 O 上,最後一個 O 不用再牽別人。
howto.en: How to build: put C in the middle and attach 3 O atoms. Then attach H to one O and Na to another O. The last O stays as it is.

fact.zh: 白色粉末,遇到酸會冒出氣泡。
fact.en: A white powder that fizzes with acid.

use.zh: 做蛋糕、饅頭讓麵團膨起來,也能去除異味。
use.en: Makes cakes rise and removes odors.

factTeen.zh: 白色粉末,遇到酸會產生二氧化碳氣泡。
factTeen.en: A white powder that fizzes with carbon dioxide when it meets an acid.

useTeen.zh: 烘焙時讓麵團膨脹,也可以用來去除異味。
useTeen.en: Makes dough rise in baking, and can also remove odors.

factHigh.zh: 受熱分解會放出 CO₂ 與水(2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O + CO₂);遇酸也會放出 CO₂。
factHigh.en: It decomposes on heating, releasing CO₂ and water (2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O + CO₂), and also releases CO₂ with acids.

useHigh.zh: 烘焙用的膨鬆劑(小蘇打)、胃藥的成分與清潔劑。
useHigh.en: A leavening agent in baking (baking soda), an antacid ingredient and a cleaning agent.

fact.zh: 雞蛋殼、貝殼、珍珠、石灰岩都是它。
fact.en: Eggshells, seashells, pearls and limestone.

use.zh: 補鈣片、粉筆、水泥的原料。
use.en: Calcium tablets, chalk and cement.

factTeen.zh: 雞蛋殼、貝殼和石灰岩的主要成分。
factTeen.en: The main component of eggshells, seashells and limestone.

useTeen.zh: 補鈣片、粉筆與水泥的原料。
useTeen.en: A raw material for calcium tablets, chalk and cement.

factHigh.zh: 遇酸會放出 CO₂;高溫下分解成 CaO 與 CO₂。
factHigh.en: It releases CO₂ with acids, and decomposes at high temperature into CaO and CO₂.

useHigh.zh: 石灰岩與大理石的主要成分,用於製造水泥、石灰與補鈣劑。
useHigh.en: The main component of limestone and marble, used to make cement, lime and calcium supplements.

fact.zh: 火山和燃燒煤炭會產生的刺鼻氣體。
fact.en: A sharp gas released by volcanoes and burning coal.

use.zh: 是造成酸雨的原因之一,所以要減少汙染。
use.en: A cause of acid rain, so we should cut pollution.

factHigh.zh: 彎曲形分子(鍵角約 119°),燃燒含硫燃料時產生,溶於水形成亞硫酸。
factHigh.en: A bent molecule (bond angle about 119°) produced when sulfur-containing fuels burn; it dissolves in water to form sulfurous acid.

useHigh.zh: 工業上用來製造硫酸與作為食品防腐劑(亞硫酸鹽類),也是酸雨的前驅物。
useHigh.en: Used to make sulfuric acid and, as sulfites, as a food preservative; it is also a precursor of acid rain.

howto.zh: 拼法:讓 1 個 N 在中間,左右各牽 1 個 O。N 會剩下一隻手空著,這是正常的!
howto.en: Build: put 1 N in the middle with 1 O on each side. N keeps one hand free - that is normal!

fact.zh: 棕黃色的氣體。它有一隻手永遠牽不滿,所以特別活潑、容易跟別人反應!畫面上一邊雙鍵、一邊單鍵只是其中一種畫法:真實的兩個 N–O 鍵一樣長、一樣強,多出來的電子是平均分給兩邊的(這叫「共振」)。
fact.en: A brown gas. One of its hands can never be filled, so it is very active! Drawing one double bond and one single bond is just one way to write it: in the real molecule both N-O bonds are equally long and strong, because the extra electrons are shared evenly (this is called resonance).

use.zh: 汽車廢氣和工廠排放的空氣汙染物,是霧霾的原因之一。
use.en: A pollutant from car exhaust and factories that adds to smog.

factTeen.zh: 棕黃色的氣體。它有 1 個沒配對的電子,所以特別活潑。兩個 N–O 鍵其實一樣長,畫面上一雙一單只是「共振」的其中一種畫法。
factTeen.en: A brown-yellow gas. It has one unpaired electron, so it is very reactive. The two N–O bonds are really the same length; the double-plus-single drawing is just one way to show "resonance".

factHigh.zh: 棕色氣體,價電子數為奇數,有 1 個未成對電子。兩個 N–O 鍵等長(鍵級約 1.5),是共振混成的結果,畫面上的一雙一單只是其中一種共振式。
factHigh.en: A brown gas with an odd number of valence electrons and one unpaired electron. The two N–O bonds are equal in length (bond order about 1.5) because of resonance; the double-plus-single drawing is only one resonance form.

useHigh.zh: 燃燒過程產生的空氣汙染物,與水反應可形成硝酸,是酸雨與光化學煙霧的成因之一。
useHigh.en: An air pollutant produced by combustion; it reacts with water to form nitric acid and contributes to acid rain and photochemical smog.

fact.zh: 植物用陽光、水和二氧化碳做出來的糖。
fact.en: The sugar plants make from sunlight, water and CO2.

use.zh: 是我們身體和大腦的能量來源。
use.en: The energy source for your body and brain.

factHigh.zh: 分子式 C₆H₁₂O₆ 的己醣,是光合作用的產物(6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂);圖中是 β-D-吡喃葡萄糖。
factHigh.en: A hexose with the formula C₆H₁₂O₆, the product of photosynthesis (6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂); the structure shown is β-D-glucopyranose.

useHigh.zh: 細胞呼吸的主要燃料,在體內氧化並釋放能量以合成 ATP。
useHigh.en: The main fuel for cellular respiration; it is oxidized in the body and the energy released is used to make ATP.

fact.zh: 每個碳都跟四個碳手牽手,排成立體網格,所以超級硬。
fact.en: Each carbon holds four others in a 3D grid, so it is super hard.

use.zh: 閃亮的寶石,也用來切割堅硬的東西。
use.en: Sparkling gems, and cutting tools for hard stuff.

factTeen.zh: 每個碳原子與四個碳原子以共價鍵相連,形成立體網狀結構,所以非常硬。
factTeen.en: Each carbon atom is covalently bonded to four others in a three-dimensional network, which makes diamond extremely hard.

factHigh.zh: 每個 C 以 sp³ 混成與 4 個 C 形成共價鍵,構成立體網狀的共價晶體,硬度極高、熔點很高。
factHigh.en: Each C forms four covalent bonds to other C atoms through sp³ hybridization, giving a three-dimensional covalent network crystal of extreme hardness and very high melting point.

useTeen.zh: 作為寶石,也用來切割堅硬的材料。
useTeen.en: Used as a gemstone and for cutting hard materials.

useHigh.zh: 寶石與工業切割、研磨材料;熱導率極高。
useHigh.en: A gemstone and an industrial cutting and grinding material; it has very high thermal conductivity.

fact.zh: 碳排成一層一層的蜂巢,層與層很容易滑開。
fact.en: Carbon in honeycomb sheets that slide over each other.

use.zh: 鉛筆寫字時,一層層的石墨就留在紙上。
use.en: When you write, layers of graphite stay on the paper.

factTeen.zh: 碳原子排成一層一層的六角形,層與層之間很容易滑動。
factTeen.en: Carbon atoms form layers of hexagons, and the layers slide over each other easily.

useTeen.zh: 鉛筆芯的材料,寫字時一層層的石墨留在紙上。
useTeen.en: The material of pencil leads: layers of graphite are left on the paper as you write.

factHigh.zh: 每個 C 以 sp² 混成與 3 個 C 形成六角形的層;層間以微弱的凡得瓦力結合,層內有可自由移動的電子,所以能導電。
factHigh.en: Each C forms a hexagonal layer with 3 other C atoms through sp² hybridization; layers are held by weak van der Waals forces, and delocalized electrons within the layers let graphite conduct electricity.

useHigh.zh: 鉛筆芯、潤滑劑與電極材料。
useHigh.en: Pencil leads, lubricants and electrode material.

fact.zh: 黃綠色、有刺鼻味道的氣體,有毒。兩個氯手牽手,就變成氯氣。
fact.en: A yellow-green gas with a sharp smell, and it is poisonous. Two chlorine atoms holding hands make chlorine gas.

use.zh: 早期用來消毒自來水;現在游泳池和漂白水裡的消毒成分也是含氯的。
use.en: Once widely used to disinfect tap water; pool and bleach disinfectants are chlorine-based too.

factTeen.zh: 黃綠色、有刺鼻味道的有毒氣體。兩個氯原子共用一對電子形成氯分子。
factTeen.en: A yellow-green, sharp-smelling, poisonous gas. Two chlorine atoms share one pair of electrons to make a chlorine molecule.

factHigh.zh: 黃綠色的有毒氣體,是以 Cl–Cl 單鍵結合的雙原子分子,氧化力強。
factHigh.en: A yellow-green poisonous gas; a diatomic molecule with a Cl–Cl single bond and strong oxidizing power.

useTeen.zh: 早期用來消毒自來水;游泳池與漂白水裡的消毒成分也是含氯的。
useTeen.en: Once widely used to disinfect tap water; the disinfectants in swimming pools and bleach also contain chlorine.

useHigh.zh: 自來水與泳池消毒、製造 PVC 塑膠與漂白劑的原料。
useHigh.en: Used to disinfect tap water and swimming pools, and as a raw material for PVC plastic and bleach.

fact.zh: 鐵碰到水和空氣慢慢變成的紅褐色粉末。
fact.en: The red-brown powder iron slowly turns into with water and air.

use.zh: 鐵製品生鏽就是它,也用來做紅色顏料。
use.en: What rust is made of; also a red pigment.

factTeen.zh: 鐵與水和空氣作用後慢慢形成的紅褐色粉末。
factTeen.en: A red-brown powder that forms slowly when iron reacts with water and air.

useTeen.zh: 鐵生鏽的主要產物,也可用作紅色顏料。
useTeen.en: The main product of rusting, and also used as a red pigment.

factHigh.zh: 鐵在潮濕空氣中氧化的主要產物(鐵鏽的主成分),Fe 為 +3 價。
factHigh.en: The main product of iron oxidizing in damp air (the main component of rust), with iron in the +3 state.

useHigh.zh: 紅色顏料與煉鐵的原料(赤鐵礦)。
useHigh.en: A red pigment and an ore for ironmaking (hematite).

fact.zh: 氫和氟牽手,溶在水裡會變成能蝕刻玻璃的氫氟酸。
fact.en: Hydrogen holds hands with fluorine. In water it etches glass.

use.zh: 用來在玻璃上蝕刻花紋,需要大人在實驗室使用。
use.en: Used to etch glass, only by experts.

factTeen.zh: 氫和氟共用一對電子,溶在水裡成為能蝕刻玻璃的氫氟酸。
factTeen.en: Hydrogen and fluorine share one pair of electrons; dissolved in water it becomes hydrofluoric acid, which can etch glass.

factHigh.zh: H–F 是高極性的共價鍵,HF 分子之間會形成氫鍵;水溶液(氫氟酸)是弱酸,卻能腐蝕玻璃。
factHigh.en: The H–F bond is highly polar and HF molecules hydrogen-bond to each other; the aqueous solution (hydrofluoric acid) is a weak acid yet corrodes glass.

useHigh.zh: 用於蝕刻玻璃與半導體製程;腐蝕性強、毒性高,只能由受過訓練的專業人員處理。
useHigh.en: Used to etch glass and in semiconductor processing; highly corrosive and toxic, to be handled only by trained professionals.

fact.zh: 紅棕色的液體,會冒出刺鼻的煙。
fact.en: A red-brown liquid that gives off sharp fumes.

use.zh: 用來製造藥品和阻燃劑。
use.en: Used to make medicines and flame retardants.

factHigh.zh: 常溫下為紅棕色液體(少數在常溫呈液態的非金屬單質之一),容易揮發。
factHigh.en: A red-brown liquid at room temperature (one of the few nonmetallic elements that is liquid there), and volatile.

useHigh.zh: 製造阻燃劑、藥品與農藥的原料。
useHigh.en: A raw material for flame retardants, drugs and pesticides.

fact.zh: 紫黑色的晶體,加熱會直接變成紫色氣體。
fact.en: Purple-black crystals that turn straight into purple gas.

use.zh: 碘酒可以幫傷口消毒;身體需要一點點碘才能製造甲狀腺素。
use.en: Iodine tincture cleans wounds; your body needs a little iodine.

factHigh.zh: 紫黑色固體,容易昇華成紫色蒸氣。
factHigh.en: A violet-black solid that readily sublimes into violet vapor.

useHigh.zh: 碘酒用於消毒;人體需要碘來合成甲狀腺素。
useHigh.en: Tincture of iodine is used as an antiseptic, and the body needs iodine to make thyroid hormone.

fact.zh: 很多這種小單元連成長長的鏈子,就是鐵氟龍,超級滑。
fact.en: Many of these units join into a long chain called Teflon - super slippery.

use.zh: 不沾鍋的塗層,煎蛋不會黏。
use.en: The coating of non-stick pans.

factHigh.zh: 四氟乙烯單體,聚合後成為聚四氟乙烯(PTFE,商品名鐵氟龍);C–F 鍵很強,化學性質非常穩定。
factHigh.en: The tetrafluoroethylene monomer, which polymerizes into PTFE (trade name Teflon); the C–F bond is very strong, making the polymer chemically very stable.

useHigh.zh: 不沾鍋塗層,以及耐腐蝕的管材與墊片。
useHigh.en: Non-stick cookware coatings, and corrosion-resistant tubing and gaskets.

fact.zh: 很強的鹼,會讓皮膚受傷,要小心。
fact.en: A strong base that can hurt skin.

use.zh: 製作肥皂、通水管的原料(請大人使用)。
use.en: Used to make soap and unblock drains (adults only).

factHigh.zh: 強鹼(離子化合物),溶於水時放熱並完全解離出 OH⁻;具有強腐蝕性。
factHigh.en: A strong base (ionic compound) that releases heat when dissolved and dissociates completely to give OH⁻; strongly corrosive.

useHigh.zh: 製造肥皂(皂化反應)、紙漿與清潔劑,也用於疏通管道。
useHigh.en: Used to make soap (saponification), paper pulp and cleaners, and to clear drains.

fact.zh: 漂白水的主要成分,可以殺死細菌。
fact.en: The main part of bleach, which kills germs.

use.zh: 消毒、漂白衣服(不能和別的清潔劑混在一起)。
use.en: Disinfecting and bleaching (never mix with other cleaners).

factHigh.zh: 次氯酸鈉是強氧化劑,是漂白水的有效成分;與酸混合會釋出有毒的氯氣。
factHigh.en: Sodium hypochlorite is a strong oxidizer and the active ingredient of bleach; mixed with acids it releases toxic chlorine gas.

useHigh.zh: 消毒與漂白;切勿與酸性清潔劑混用。
useHigh.en: Disinfection and bleaching; never mix it with acidic cleaners.

fact.zh: 非常強的酸,會腐蝕東西,絕對不能亂碰。
fact.en: A very strong acid that eats away materials.

use.zh: 汽車電池裡有它,工廠也用它做肥料。
use.en: Found in car batteries and used to make fertilizer.

factHigh.zh: 強酸;濃硫酸具有強烈的脫水性與吸水性,稀釋時會放出大量的熱。
factHigh.en: A strong acid; concentrated sulfuric acid is a powerful dehydrating agent and gives off a great deal of heat when diluted.

useHigh.zh: 鉛蓄電池的電解液,也是製造肥料與各種化學品的大宗原料。
useHigh.en: The electrolyte in lead-acid batteries, and a bulk raw material for fertilizers and many chemicals.

fact.zh: 磷在中間,抓著四個氧,其中三個還帶著氫。
fact.en: Phosphorus holds four oxygens, three of them carrying hydrogens.

use.zh: 可樂的酸味來源,也用在肥料裡。
use.en: Gives cola its tang and goes into fertilizer.

factTeen.zh: 磷在中間連著四個氧原子,其中三個氧還連著氫。
factTeen.en: Phosphorus sits in the middle bonded to four oxygen atoms, three of which also carry a hydrogen.

factHigh.zh: 中心的 P 與 4 個 O 相連(1 個 P=O、3 個 P–OH),是三質子酸(弱酸)。
factHigh.en: The central P is bonded to 4 O atoms (one P=O and three P–OH); it is a triprotic weak acid.

useHigh.zh: 可樂等飲料的酸味劑,也用於製造磷肥。
useHigh.en: An acidulant in drinks such as cola, and used to make phosphate fertilizers.

fact.zh: 四個磷原子排成小金字塔。很容易著火,要泡在水裡保存。
fact.en: Four phosphorus atoms in a tiny pyramid. It catches fire easily.

use.zh: 磷是火柴頭的原料,也是骨頭和 DNA 需要的元素。
use.en: Phosphorus is in match heads, bones and DNA.

factHigh.zh: 白磷是 P₄ 正四面體分子,P–P–P 鍵角只有 60°,張力大,容易自燃,需保存在水中。
factHigh.en: White phosphorus is a tetrahedral P₄ molecule with P–P–P angles of only 60°; the strain makes it ignite spontaneously, so it is stored under water.

useHigh.zh: 磷是 DNA、ATP 與骨骼的重要元素;白磷用於製造磷酸等化學品。
useHigh.en: Phosphorus is vital in DNA, ATP and bones; white phosphorus is used to make chemicals such as phosphoric acid.

fact.zh: 八個硫原子連成皺皺的皇冠環,是黃色粉末。
fact.en: Eight sulfur atoms in a crown-shaped ring: a yellow powder.

use.zh: 溫泉的味道、火柴和火藥都有它。
use.en: Found at hot springs, in matches and fireworks.

factHigh.zh: S₈ 是皇冠形的環狀分子,常溫下為黃色固體,是硫最穩定的同素異形體(斜方硫)。
factHigh.en: S₈ is a crown-shaped ring molecule, a yellow solid at room temperature and the most stable allotrope of sulfur (orthorhombic sulfur).

useHigh.zh: 製造硫酸、橡膠硫化與火藥的原料。
useHigh.en: A raw material for sulfuric acid, rubber vulcanization and gunpowder.

fact.zh: 沙子、水晶和玻璃的主要成分。
fact.en: The main part of sand, quartz and glass.

use.zh: 蓋房子的玻璃、水晶球都是它。
use.en: Window glass and crystal balls.

factHigh.zh: 共價網狀固體,每個 Si 與 4 個 O 相連;α-石英是常見的結晶形式,熔點很高。
factHigh.en: A covalent network solid in which each Si is bonded to 4 O atoms; α-quartz is the common crystal form, with a very high melting point.

useHigh.zh: 石英、玻璃與矽晶片的原料。
useHigh.en: A raw material for quartz, glass and silicon wafers.

fact.zh: 超級白的粉末,會擋住紫外線。
fact.en: A super-white powder that blocks UV light.

use.zh: 白色顏料和防曬乳。
use.en: White paint and sunscreen.

factHigh.zh: 白色粉末,折射率高、遮蔽力強,也能吸收紫外線。
factHigh.en: A white powder with a high refractive index and strong opacity; it also absorbs ultraviolet light.

useHigh.zh: 白色顏料(塗料、紙張)與防曬乳。
useHigh.en: White pigment (paint, paper) and sunscreen.

fact.zh: 透明又能導電的神奇材料。
fact.en: A clear material that can carry electricity.

use.zh: 觸控螢幕和太陽能板的透明導電層。
use.en: The transparent conductor in touchscreens.

factHigh.zh: 寬能隙的半導體氧化物,可製成透明導電薄膜。
factHigh.en: A wide-band-gap semiconducting oxide that can be made into transparent conductive films.

useHigh.zh: 透明導電膜(顯示器、太陽能電池)與氣體感測器。
useHigh.en: Transparent conductive films (displays, solar cells) and gas sensors.

fact.zh: 黑色的陶瓷小顆粒,裡面藏著很大的能量。
fact.en: Small black ceramic pellets full of energy.

use.zh: 核能發電廠的燃料(有輻射,只有專家處理)。
use.en: Nuclear power fuel, handled only by experts.

factHigh.zh: 黑色的陶瓷狀固體(螢石結構),熔點極高,具有放射性。
factHigh.en: A black ceramic-like solid (fluorite structure) with an extremely high melting point; radioactive.

useHigh.zh: 核電廠的主要核燃料(濃縮鈾燒結成燃料丸)。
useHigh.en: The main nuclear fuel in power plants (enriched uranium sintered into pellets).

fact.zh: 混進一點別的金屬,就變成紅寶石或藍寶石。
fact.en: A pinch of another metal turns it into ruby or sapphire.

use.zh: 寶石、砂紙的磨料,鋁表面的保護膜也是它。
use.en: Gems, sandpaper grit and the skin on aluminium.

factHigh.zh: 剛玉結構;含微量 Cr³⁺ 的是紅寶石,含 Fe、Ti 雜質的是藍寶石。
factHigh.en: The corundum structure; with traces of Cr³⁺ it is ruby, and with Fe and Ti impurities it is sapphire.

useHigh.zh: 磨料、耐火材料與陶瓷;鋁表面的保護氧化膜。
useHigh.en: Abrasives, refractories and ceramics; also the protective oxide film on aluminum.

fact.zh: 白色的小晶體,泡在水裡很好溶解。
fact.en: Small white crystals that dissolve in water.

use.zh: 泡腳的浴鹽、植物的鎂肥。
use.en: Bath salts and plant fertilizer.

factHigh.zh: 常見的水合物是七水合物(瀉鹽,MgSO₄·7H₂O),易溶於水。
factHigh.en: The common hydrate is the heptahydrate (Epsom salt, MgSO₄·7H₂O), which dissolves easily in water.

useHigh.zh: 浴鹽、鎂肥與醫療用瀉劑。
useHigh.en: Bath salts, magnesium fertilizer and a medical laxative.

fact.zh: 美麗的藍色晶體,溶在水裡整杯水都變藍。
fact.en: Beautiful blue crystals that turn water blue.

use.zh: 科學實驗長晶體、農場殺菌(有毒,不能吃)。
use.en: Growing crystals and farm fungicide (poisonous!).

factHigh.zh: 五水合物(膽礬,CuSO₄·5H₂O)是藍色晶體,加熱失去結晶水後變成白色粉末。
factHigh.en: The pentahydrate (blue vitriol, CuSO₄·5H₂O) forms blue crystals, which turn into a white powder when heated and lose their water of crystallization.

useHigh.zh: 波爾多液殺菌劑、電鍍,以及實驗室檢驗水的存在。
useHigh.en: Bordeaux mixture fungicide, electroplating, and a laboratory test for the presence of water.

fact.zh: 白色粉末,是做鋰電池的重要原料。
fact.en: A white powder, key for making lithium batteries.

use.zh: 手機、電動車的鋰電池。
use.en: Phone and electric-car batteries.

factHigh.zh: 白色粉末,微溶於水,是製造鋰化合物的主要原料。
factHigh.en: A white powder, slightly soluble in water and the main raw material for making lithium compounds.

useHigh.zh: 鋰電池材料,也用於玻璃與陶瓷,醫療上用於治療躁鬱症。
useHigh.en: Lithium battery material, also used in glass and ceramics, and medically for bipolar disorder.

fact.zh: 白色晶體,含有植物最愛的鉀和氮。
fact.en: White crystals with the potassium and nitrogen plants love.

use.zh: 肥料,也是煙火的材料。
use.en: Fertilizer and an ingredient in fireworks.

factHigh.zh: 離子化合物,含有鉀與氮兩種植物養分,也是氧化劑。
factHigh.en: An ionic compound containing the plant nutrients potassium and nitrogen; it is also an oxidizer.

useHigh.zh: 肥料、黑火藥與煙火的成分。
useHigh.en: An ingredient of fertilizer, black powder and fireworks.

fact.zh: 鈉和氟配成一對。
fact.en: A sodium and a fluorine pair.

use.zh: 牙膏裡的氟,幫牙齒抵抗蛀蟲。
use.en: The fluoride in toothpaste that protects teeth.

factHigh.zh: 離子化合物(岩鹽結構),氟離子可以強化牙釉質。
factHigh.en: An ionic compound (rock salt structure); fluoride ions strengthen tooth enamel.

useHigh.zh: 牙膏與飲水加氟的氟化物來源。
useHigh.en: A fluoride source for toothpaste and water fluoridation.

fact.zh: 像食鹽,不過是鉀和氯配成對。
fact.en: Like salt, but with potassium.

use.zh: 代用鹽、植物肥料。
use.en: Salt substitute and fertilizer.

factHigh.zh: 離子化合物,與氯化鈉相同,是岩鹽結構的離子晶體。
factHigh.en: An ionic compound with the same rock salt structure as sodium chloride.

useHigh.zh: 鉀肥與低鈉鹽的原料。
useHigh.en: A raw material for potash fertilizer and low-sodium salt.

fact.zh: 鉀和碘配成一對。
fact.en: A potassium and an iodine pair.

use.zh: 加碘鹽裡的碘,幫身體製造甲狀腺素。
use.en: The iodine in iodized salt.

factHigh.zh: 離子化合物(岩鹽結構),易溶於水,能溶解碘形成 I₃⁻。
factHigh.en: An ionic compound (rock salt structure) that dissolves easily in water and dissolves iodine to form I₃⁻.

useHigh.zh: 加碘鹽的碘來源,也用於防止放射性碘進入甲狀腺。
useHigh.en: The iodine source in iodized salt, also used to keep radioactive iodine out of the thyroid.

fact.zh: 白色粉末,照到光會慢慢變黑。
fact.en: A white powder that slowly darkens in light.

use.zh: 傳統相片的感光材料。
use.en: Used in old photo paper.

factHigh.zh: 難溶於水的白色離子化合物,見光會分解出銀而變黑。
factHigh.en: A white, sparingly soluble ionic compound that darkens in light as silver is released.

useHigh.zh: 傳統相紙的感光材料與電極。
useHigh.en: Light-sensitive material for traditional photographic paper, and electrodes.

fact.zh: 照到光就會起變化的淡黃色粉末。
fact.en: A pale powder that changes in light.

use.zh: 傳統底片就是靠它拍出照片。
use.en: Old camera film used it to take pictures.

factHigh.zh: 淡黃色、難溶於水,見光會分解出銀,是傳統底片的感光成分。
factHigh.en: A pale yellow, sparingly soluble compound that releases silver in light; the light-sensitive component of traditional film.

useHigh.zh: 傳統底片與相紙的感光材料。
useHigh.en: Light-sensitive material for traditional film and photographic paper.

fact.en: Four carbons in a row. A little pressure turns it into a liquid, so it fits inside a small lighter.

use.zh: 打火機、卡式瓦斯爐的燃料。
use.en: Fuel for lighters and portable gas stoves.

factHigh.zh: 含四個碳的烷類(正丁烷),稍加壓即液化,常溫下為氣體。
factHigh.en: A four-carbon alkane (n-butane) that liquefies under slight pressure and is a gas at room temperature.

useHigh.zh: 打火機與卡式瓦斯爐的燃料。
useHigh.en: Fuel for lighters and portable gas stoves.

fact.zh: 有刺鼻味道的氣體。新裝潢、新家具可能會慢慢放出來,所以新家要常常開窗通風。
fact.en: A sharp-smelling gas. New furniture and paint can release it slowly, so open the windows in a new home.

use.zh: 製作膠合板和塑膠的原料;保存標本用的福馬林是它的水溶液。
use.en: Used to make plywood and plastics; formalin, which preserves specimens, is its water solution.

factHigh.zh: 最簡單的醛(甲醛),水溶液稱為福馬林,有刺激性且具致癌性。
factHigh.en: The simplest aldehyde (formaldehyde); its aqueous solution is formalin, which is irritating and carcinogenic.

useHigh.zh: 製造樹脂與膠合板的原料;福馬林用於保存標本。
useHigh.en: A raw material for resins and plywood; formalin is used to preserve specimens.

fact.zh: 二氧化碳溶進水裡,就有一點點變成碳酸。它不太穩定,很容易又變回二氧化碳,所以汽水一打開就會冒泡泡。
fact.en: Carbon dioxide dissolved in water turns a little into carbonic acid. It is unstable and turns back into CO2, which is why soda fizzes when opened.

use.zh: 汽水、氣泡水酸酸的味道。
use.en: The slightly sour taste of soda and sparkling water.

factHigh.zh: CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃ 的產物,是不穩定的弱酸,容易分解回 CO₂ 與水。
factHigh.en: The product of CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃; an unstable weak acid that readily decomposes back to CO₂ and water.

useHigh.zh: 碳酸飲料的酸味來源,也是血液酸鹼緩衝系統的一部分。
useHigh.en: The source of the tang in carbonated drinks, and part of the acid–base buffer system in blood.

fact.zh: 身體分解蛋白質之後會產生尿素,再從尿液排出去。
fact.en: Your body makes urea when it breaks down protein, and gets rid of it in urine.

use.zh: 農田的氮肥,也是護手霜的保濕成分。
use.en: A nitrogen fertilizer, and a moisturizer in hand creams.

factHigh.zh: 蛋白質代謝產生的含氮廢物,經腎臟隨尿液排出;1828 年維勒由無機物合成出尿素。
factHigh.en: A nitrogen-containing waste of protein metabolism excreted in urine; in 1828 Wöhler synthesized urea from inorganic substances.

useHigh.zh: 重要的氮肥,也是保濕劑。
useHigh.en: An important nitrogen fertilizer, and also a moisturizing agent.

fact.zh: 指甲油去光水的味道,就是它!很容易揮發,也很容易著火。
fact.en: That smell of nail polish remover is acetone! It evaporates quickly and catches fire easily.

use.zh: 去光水和各種溶劑。
use.en: Nail polish remover and many solvents.

factHigh.zh: 最簡單的酮(丙酮),易揮發、易燃,可與水互溶。
factHigh.en: The simplest ketone (acetone); volatile, flammable and miscible with water.

useHigh.zh: 常用的溶劑,也是去光水的成分。
useHigh.en: A common solvent and an ingredient of nail polish remover.

fact.zh: 臭雞蛋、溫泉區和腐爛食物的臭味就是它。濃度高的時候有毒,聞到很濃的臭味要趕快離開。
fact.en: The smell of rotten eggs, hot springs and spoiled food. It is poisonous when concentrated, so leave if the smell is very strong.

use.zh: 火山、溫泉和下水道裡都可能出現。
use.en: Found near volcanoes, hot springs and sewers.

factHigh.zh: 彎曲形分子,有臭雞蛋氣味,劇毒;高濃度時會麻痺嗅覺,反而聞不到。
factHigh.en: A bent molecule with a rotten-egg smell and very toxic; at high concentrations it numbs the sense of smell, so it can no longer be detected.

useHigh.zh: 火山氣體、溫泉與腐敗物中的成分;工業上用於製造硫化物。
useHigh.en: A component of volcanic gas, hot springs and decay; used industrially to make sulfides.
